runtime: Compiler-provided newlib-nano stdio, full-newlib allocation family, bounded SDK heap adapter, libm/libgcc/libnosys and pinned Energia/TI SDK

suites.name: sensors
suites.scope: Exact returned binary32 bits across ADC 0..4095; pin26 session1 and pin25 sessions1/2/4. Original math instructions and linked rebuilt math library execute.

suites.name: actuators
suites.scope: Ordered GPIO/mode/delay calls and meaningful returns; original filter predicate executes. UI pause/prompt boundaries are controlled and restore the filter.

suites.name: state_pid
suites.scope: Original global initializer/PID/telemetry/menu/numeric instructions versus portable compiled C; 8 KiB of application RAM, service ordering and state at each service boundary compared. SDK construction/registration calls mocked.

suites.name: control
suites.scope: Compiled relocatable C including real C PID versus original ARM ISR/control/PID instructions. State bytes, signal values, meaningful return values, and ordered I/O events compared.

suites.name: phases
suites.scope: Exact controller/auxiliary state bytes, meaningful returns, and ordered I/O events with state snapshots. Original and rebuilt phase, control/PID, filter debounce and actuator logic execute.

suites.name: device
suites.scope: Original and rebuilt device instructions; exact ordered auxiliary SPI, GPIO, clock, UI/error/log boundary events and application state. Filter predicate, actuator and controller-stop functions are previously verified service boundaries.

suites.name: rfid
suites.scope: Original and rebuilt RFID register, FIFO, CRC, request, anti-collision/select, power and probe instructions execute. Hardware SPI/GPIO/register behavior is a deterministic model; state, returns and exact I/O ordering compared.

suites.name: rfid_application
suites.scope: Application UID reads run through actual RFID register/FIFO/CRC/select code, deterministic SPI model, encoder/filter/time boundaries. Error, cancellation, filter timeout and UID lengths compared; capacity repairs checked with canaries.

suites.name: application
suites.scope: Original/rebuilt startup and six-way main menu orchestration traces, required application service tables and real network-to-display context binding. Domain workflows are intercepted here and tested separately.

suites.name: network
suites.scope: Function-level original Thumb/recompiled ARM differential and bounded I/O scenarios; no radio, flash-device, MCU or appliance test.

suites.name: network_direct
suites.scope:
Direct comparisons for previously review-only Pico network/storage entries.

Original Thumb and rebuilt ARM bodies execute independently. Subordinate
services are controlled explicitly; state, returns and ordered effects are
compared. Folded helpers and deliberate repaired inputs are labeled separately.
No socket, radio, flash, or physical brewer is operated.

suites.name: network_direct_still
suites.scope:
Original/rebuilt Still-network comparisons at explicit subordinate boundaries.

The real original and reconstructed control flow, formatting, parsers, owned
state and failure handling execute. Scripted Still replies and SDK/UI services
replace external I/O. Folded IPv4 helpers and malformed-input repairs are
identified separately. No hardware or network session is operated.

suites.name: recipe
suites.scope: UI, network, clock, mechanics, and previously verified core controller/phase routines are explicit controlled boundaries. The original and candidate run in separate ARM emulator instances.

suites.name: ui
suites.scope: Original/rebuilt ARM states and ordered observable effects; domain report records exact cases.

suites.name: ui_interactions
suites.scope: Original/rebuilt ARM states and ordered observable effects; domain report records exact cases.

suites.name: ui_workflows
suites.scope: Original/rebuilt ARM states and ordered observable effects; domain report records exact cases.

suites.name: ui_direct_display
suites.scope:
Direct original/rebuilt ARM checks for the remaining display-side entries.

Draws through the real reconstructed and original rasterizers. OLED flushes,
clocks and SDK MAC retrieval are explicit boundaries; returned strings,
assertions/logging, mutable state, complete framebuffers and flush sequences
are compared. Removed SDK field thunks are compared with owned public fields.

suites.name: ui_direct_menus
suites.scope: Direct original and reconstructed ARM entry execution with actual rasterization and menu/state mutation. Ordered screen, input, actuator, storage, network and diagnostic-dispatch effects are compared at explicitly controlled subordinate boundaries. Synthetic callback tables use compiler DWARF field offsets. No physical peripheral timing, appliance startup or complete brew is exercised.

suites.name: ui_direct_workflows
suites.scope: Direct original/rebuilt ARM entry execution. Actual framebuffers, flushed frames, menu labels, settings, returns and ordered service requests are compared; hardware/network/recipe services and user input are explicitly controlled. Not physical or exhaustive path validation.

production_source_check.scope: No old application RAM/code address calls, unresolved-return macros or raw decompiler labels in production C/C++ after removing comments. Explicit TI peripheral addresses are allowed.

limits: Counts combine exact original/rebuilt ARM comparisons, documented bounded-input regressions and concrete integration checks. Complete entry accounting is not exhaustive path coverage. No physical device, real radio/flash, interrupt race, full brew, installation or recovery test was performed.
